title: Workspace persistence and seat-lease lifecycle
intent: Persistent seat-lease lifecycle backed by an on-disk journal. Workspace stores own the conflict-detection and TTL-expiry loop. CLI commands fabric workspace {list,show,acquire,release,gc} become the user-facing surface for interacting with the lease system.
non_goals: Cross-host lease replication (deferred to R2 — ADR-0025 trust_scope is currently Ephemeral only)
Lease-aware route compilation (route compiler is read-only with respect to the lease store in R1)
Surface plane integration (PF-WP-015) — the lease store is independent of surface presentation
open_questions: Should workspace.json be human-editable or written atomically via temp file + rename only? (current plan: atomic write)
Should conflict detection be per-seat-id or per-(seat-id × locality-tier)? (current plan: per-(seat-id × locality-tier))
